question: What was the yearly trend of Luxembourg's total fuel imports volume (kg) for the largest fuel product chapter Petroleum oils (HS4 2710) from 2018 to 2025?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2710')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: −25.5 % (2018–2025)
insight: Luxembourg's total fuel imports volume for Petroleum oils decreased from 2.87 billion kilograms in 2018 to 2.14 billion kilograms in 2025.
The overall change in imports volume from 2018 to 2025 was a decline of 25.5%.
The highest import volume was recorded in 2019, reaching 3.04 billion kilograms.
This trend shows a peak in 2019 followed by a steady decrease through to 2025.
The data only includes trade rows where quantities are known, so some volumes may be missing.
